mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_checkpoint (checkpoint_id, case_id, turn_id, step_id, ssm_state, state_payload, stage, created_at) VALUES (#{checkpointId}, #{caseId}, #{turnId}, #{stepId}, #{ssmState}, #{statePayload}, #{stage}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, checkpoint_id, case_id, turn_id, step_id, ssm_state, state_payload, stage, created_at FROM agent_checkpoint WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
